name: HYDRA-UMC-SDK
build: Functional JSON Schema v1 contracts, Python reference validator and conformance fixtures.
notes: The common contract and conformance boundary for services, UIs, CM5 adapters and URTC. Provides v1 JSON Schema, Python validation and conformance fixtures, plus a real, automatic compatibility matrix (tools/verify_contract_matrix.py) between the published schemas and the validator - found and fixed a real gap where the ProjectManifest (hydra-umc.project.json) contract had no validator entry at all. Package publication and further clients remain release gates.
